greek mythology.simpleMeaning: old Greek stories about gods and heroes

king.simpleMeaning: a male ruler of a country or city
king.contextMeaning: Sisyphus is the ruler of Corinth in many versions

trick.simpleMeaning: to make someone believe something false
trick.contextMeaning: Sisyphus uses clever tricks in a selfish way

punish.simpleMeaning: to make someone suffer for doing wrong
punish.contextMeaning: the gods punish Sisyphus with endless work

escape.simpleMeaning: to get away from danger or limits

fate.simpleMeaning: something that seems decided and cannot be avoided
fate.contextMeaning: death is the fate Sisyphus tries to avoid

symbol.simpleMeaning: something that stands for a bigger idea
symbol.contextMeaning: the rock stands for repeated work and responsibility

responsibility.simpleMeaning: something you must take care of
